title: Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23862v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. translated_title: 基于动作条件化世界模型的电子健康记录患者轨迹预测
translated_abstract: 我们为电子健康记录（EHR）引入了一种预测性世界模型，将患者历史表示为动作条件化的潜在轨迹。我们的框架不再仅通过自回归标记预测来建模临床事件，而是显式地将患者状态与观察到的临床行动分离，并通过一个以状态和动作为条件的转移算子来学习它们的演化。该框架的核心是一个状态依赖的线性化预测器，它能够传播潜在患者状态中的局部变化，从而实现时间分辨预测、多步推演以及动作条件化模拟。实验表明，生成的潜在轨迹保留了编码器派生表示中存在的下游预测信号、时间结构和子群体层面的统计关系。我们进一步将自由运行的推演结果解码到原始临床特征空间，并将未来的临床测量结果与观察数据进行对比评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种动作条件化的世界模型，通过显式分离患者状态与临床行动并采用状态依赖的线性化预测器，实现了电子健康记录中患者轨迹的时间分辨预测、多步推演和动作条件化模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an action-conditioned world model for EHR that explicitly separates patient states from clinical actions and uses a state-dependent linearization predictor to enable time-resolved prediction, multi-step rollout, and action-conditioned simulation of patient trajectories.
